caption: Two parallel routes: skin contact runs through the four mechanoreceptors and an afferent nerve to the S1 cortex, while limb movement reaches the cerebellum through spindles and tendon organs. The highlighted box is the receptor set that fixes pin pitch and actuator frequency.

spec.aria: Two parallel sensory paths, a cutaneous path from skin contact through mechanoreceptors and nerve to cortex, and a kinesthetic path from limb movement through spindles and tendon organs to the cerebellum.
